Another angle shows Marco Rubio sitting next to Trump. It then cuts to another split-screen from "last year," showing podcaster Lex Fridman in one panel and Donald Trump in another, both speaking into microphones with American flags in the background. The video concludes with a still photograph of Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein together.
